بلبل.en: Bulbul (the advisor persona, the site mascot)
بلبل.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-bulbul (HTTP 200, 2026-10-27): «بُلْبُل — اسم، مؤنث، واحد» (the bird); mascot gender already ruled مؤنث by the entry «سفید گالوں والی بلبل» (owner, N859, 2026-10-23).
بلبل.note: advisor-ui. Written as a bare proper name, no quotation marks and no gloss: the bird word and the persona name are one word, and the interface already shows the bird icon beside it. Every verb and adjective that agrees with the persona is feminine (لکھ رہی ہے، آرام کر رہی ہے، دیتی ہے، دے دوں گی). The persona says «میں بلبل ہوں» (first person; «ہوں» is gender-free). The name takes no «سفید گالوں والی» in the interface strings (the species belongs to the legal text).

مشیر.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-mushiir (HTTP 200, 2026-10-27): «مُشِیر — اسم، مذکر — مشورہ یا رائے دینے والا، تدبیر بتانے والا، صلاح دینے والا»; ur.wikipedia exact phrase «کی مشیر» 71 pages (HTTP 200, 2026-10-27).
مشیر.note: advisor-ui advisor.title «بلبل، Visit Al-Ahsa کی مشیر». Masculine headword used as an epicene predicate noun after a feminine subject; the title has no verb, so no agreement is exposed. «رہنما» refused: the site reserves it for the guide/guidebook (foot.independence, سیاحتی رہنما).

نئی گفتگو.source: ur.wikipedia exact phrases (HTTP 200, 2026-10-27): «نئی گفتگو» 3 pages, «نئی بات چیت» 4 pages, «گفتگو شروع» 27, «گفتگو کریں» 12. No dictionary entry page read for the compound (rekhta meaning-of-guftagu answered 302).
نئی گفتگو.note: advisor-ui advisor.reset (aria-label only). «گفتگو» is feminine (the dictionary form is the common one; not exercised in a sentence here). Tie with «نئی بات چیت» on the encyclopedia; choice open for the blind reader.
